author: smartypantsnet
description:
Smarty Pants Mac Benchmarks
	

Speed and quality for open models on real Apple Silicon Macs, made with our open model factory. Each section is one model on one Mac. The bold row is the base version; the rows marked ↳ are versions we built or tested to make it faster, smaller or smarter, measured the same way on the same Mac.
A version counts as better only if it is faster or smaller and its answers stay as good, or if its answers get better at the same speed. Everything else is… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/smartypantsnet/mac-benchmarks.
